title: How do I create an account?
content: Click the 'Sign Up' button on the homepage, enter your personal details, verify your email, and you're ready to access our healthcare services.

title: Can I book an appointment without registering?
content: No, registration is required to book appointments so we can securely store and manage your medical information.

title: How do I find a doctor that suits my needs?
content: Use our 'Find a Doctor' tool to filter by specialty, location, availability, and patient ratings to choose the best provider for you.

title: Is there a mobile app available?
content: Yes, our mobile app is available on both iOS and Android. You can book appointments, view records, and chat with providers on the go.

title: What payment methods are accepted?
content: We accept credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and mobile wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay. All payments are securely processed.

title: Can I pay in installments?
content: Yes, for select services we offer installment plans. You can choose this option during checkout or contact billing support for details.

title: How do I access my billing history?
content: Log into your account and navigate to the 'Billing' section to view past invoices, payment confirmations, and downloadable receipts.

title: What should I do if I was charged incorrectly?
content: Please contact our billing support team immediately with your invoice number. We'll investigate and resolve any discrepancies promptly.

title: Why can't I log into my account?
content: Double-check your email and password. If you're still having trouble, try resetting your password or contact support for help.

title: The website is not loading properly. What should I do?
content: Try refreshing the page, clearing your browser cache, or switching to a different browser. If the issue persists, reach out to tech support.

title: I didn’t receive my appointment confirmation email.
content: Check your spam folder first. If it's not there, log into your account to confirm the appointment or request a resend from the dashboard.

title: How do I update my profile information?
content: Log into your account, go to 'Settings' or 'Profile', and edit your personal details. Changes are saved automatically.
